text:
tara.partner: Hey team — Co-sell POC with Synergy kicks off next week. Quick sync on sandbox tenant provisioning, entitlements mapping, and the SLA ask. Can @mike.sales confirm the expected QPS and any committed windows? Need a shared runbook before the demo.

mike.sales: We committed to a pilot profile: burst to ~500 rps, steady ~150 rps. They asked about regional failover (eu + us). Will confirm if they want multi-region active-active or active-passive.

josh.eng: We can provision a staging tenant in eu-west-2 and us-west-2. I need the partner CIDRs and SAML metadata. What timeline are we aiming for?

tara.partner: Demo is Monday 10am PT. Ideally network + SSO done before then. Posting a quick checklist so we can triage: 1) Tenant provisioning 2) SSO/SAML exchange 3) Egress/ingress rules 4) Entitlement -> quota mapping 5) SLA language & escalation contacts 6) Security questionnaire answers

lea.solutions: For entitlements, we're mapping seats -> concurrency tokens by default. If they want team-level quotas we tag tokens with team IDs. I can draft the runbook and the entitlement mapping doc today.

sean.security: Heads up on the security questionnaire: Synergy is asking about data residency, customer-managed keys, audit log retention, and incident response SLAs. We need to confirm KMS options (BYOK for Private deployments?); hosted offering is encrypted at rest with provider-managed keys by default. I'll prepare a one-pager.

tara.partner: Quick pricing question from them — they want a blended committed price for a dedicated pool with a burst allowance. @mike.sales can you post term options (pilot vs commit) and expected delta for burst?

mike.sales: Short answer: Pilot (3mo) -> 30% off metered; 12mo commit for dedicated capacity -> price = baseline * 0.6 (example), burst billed on top at metered rate but with 2x capacity guarantee during business hours. I'll upload a detailed calc to SFDC.

josh.eng: Potential blocker: our provisioning flow requires CI runners to reach the tenant API IPs. If partner cannot open outbound, we'll need a bastion/SSM jumpbox or a temporary reverse proxy. @tara.partner do they allow egress to our CIDRs?

tara.partner: They won't open 0.0.0.0/0. They said they can allow a specific set of CIDRs and their security team needs a list. Sending the CIDR requirements in DM now.

josh.eng: Thanks. Provision command I plan to run (example):
```
rdwctl tenant create \
  --name synergy-staging \
  --region eu-west-2 \
  --cidr 10.10.0.0/16 \
  --saml-metadata-file synergy_saml.xml
```
That will bootstrap SAML and tag the tenant with the partner id.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: staging-tenant-provisioner v2.1 -> 2376, ETA ~8m.

lea.solutions: I'll start the runbook skeleton and include a troubleshooting section for rate-limiting, token exhaustion, and SSO mismatches. Will push a Google Doc link once ready.

sean.security: Draft answers to the questionnaire (summary): BYOK = supported for Private deployments + upcoming hosted BYOK pilot (not GA), retention = 90 days default logs (extendable), encryption = TLS in transit + AES-256 at rest, SOC2 = yes, incident response = 24h initial contact + 72h triage window for enterprise customers. Flagging BYOK as legal/product dependency — can't promise without signoff.

mike.sales: Uploaded the preliminary quote and SLA language to SFDC (Opp 9876). Link: https://redwood.sales/opp/9876. Also cc'ing legal for quick MSA addendum for entitlements & BYOK.

tara.partner: Plan for next 48h: josh + lea provision tenant + draft runbook, sean finalizes sec questionnaire responses, mike finalizes quote & SLA, I'll coordinate partner-side SSO/CIDR handoff and confirm demo invite. Any other blockers?

josh.eng: On it. I'll request the CIDRs and SAML metadata once I get the DM. If the partner needs IP allowlist alternatives, we can spin a temporary tunnel.

lea.solutions: Added a note to include a short script for token resets and how to read token metrics in Console. Will share doc link.

sean.security: One outstanding — Synergy asked explicitly about hosted BYOK and HSM-backed KMS. Marking that as a blocker until product/legal confirm product roadmap.

mike.sales: Noted, I'll set expectation with AE and the partner that BYOK is 'on the roadmap' but requires a managed agreement.

tara.partner: Awesome. Thanks all — syncing again once runbook draft and tenant are up. :thumbsup:
